gen-gf-ysabeau-fs-literata: Open-mouthed and modern, Ysabeau has low crossbars finer than its main stems, which gives it a lightly drawn feel up top. Literata, a text serif, brings sturdier thin lines beneath, and Ysabeau earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-gf-ysabeau-infant-fs-literata: Ysabeau Infant makes a big visible entrance into every curved letter, with hairlines that stay sturdy. Literata, a text serif, adds more stroke variation underneath, so the two feel like friendly neighbors with different handwriting.
gen-gf-ysabeau-office-fs-literata: Literata is a text serif whose thin lines are sturdy and whose curves open wide without closing. And Ysabeau Office, with slightly thinner hairlines and hollow-reed counters, sits above it; give the body a little extra size.
gen-gf-ysabeau-sc-fs-literata: Open curves, easy to see into. Ysabeau SC keeps a low-contrast look up top, with a modern, plain-spoken feel. Literata, a serif, adds a faintly modulated line that gives the page more texture.
gen-gf-yuji-syuku-fs-bespoke-sans: Traditional in mood, Yuji Syuku moves from thick to thin gradually instead of snapping. Bespoke Sans below is sharper and low in contrast, with generous space between its curve ends and stems; give that body font a slightly larger size.
gen-gf-yusei-magic-fs-literata: Literata is sophisticated and bookish, with sturdy thin lines against slightly heavier thick ones. Literata and Yusei Magic work together by letting the heading's friendly, mild stroke contrast sit above the classic serif's firmer rhythm.
gen-gf-zain-fs-literata: A single-width stroke runs through every Zain glyph, like a marker nib that ignores direction. But Literata, a serif, adds subtle stroke modulation below, so the pair feels like a modern sketch next to a bookish page.
gen-gf-zalando-sans-fs-literata: Literata reads as sophisticated and bookish, its sturdy thin lines meeting slightly heavier thick ones in a mid-level contrast. And Zalando Sans, approachable and low in contrast, stands over the classic serif with see-through c openings.
gen-gf-zalando-sans-expanded-fs-literata: Zalando Sans Expanded spaces its letters wide by default, with a generous opening in the c. Literata, a text serif, feels tighter and more bookish beside it, with contrast that is subdued across the alphabet.
gen-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpanded-fs-lite: Terminals stop well short of the bowl in Zalando Sans SemiExpanded. Literata, a text serif, answers with a gentle swelling and tapering along its curves, so the pair feels crisp above and bookish below.
